entry_item.definition: adj. Feeble, powerless, weak in strength or spirit; poor, backward; small, narrow ( of dimensions and quantities).

example.definition: Weak, powerless ( as a nation or people).

blödsinnig, schwach am Verstande und Körper
Weak of intellect or body. Silly. Moderately, not too much not too little. Proper size.
